found.title: Found
found.description: True when the wallet resolved to an X handle or a Farcaster account. This is the billable predicate: ENS, Lens and GitHub alone do not count.

x_handle.title: X handle
x_handle.description: The handle the wallet owner published. Never read from a post, a display name or a bio.

x_verified.title: X attested
x_verified.description: True when the link was published by the owner rather than correlated from an index.

x_reachability.title: X reachability
x_reachability.description: live, suspended, unclaimed or reassigned. Empty means the handle was not checked, never that nobody is behind it.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The classes of evidence behind the match: onchain, farcaster, attested-social, manual, aggregated. Never a provider name.

is_agent.title: Is an agent
is_agent.description: True when the wallet belongs to an AI agent rather than a person, so it can be dropped before paying for reach.

last_updated.title: Last updated
last_updated.description: When this record was last confirmed.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when the record is older than the freshness window and may be worth re-resolving.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: A confirmed match whose identities are withheld until the allowance overflow is paid for. Not the same as a miss.

looked_up.title: Handle looked up
looked_up.description: Reverse mode only: the handle whose wallets these are.

quality_score.title: Quality score
quality_score.description: Reverse mode only: the strength of the attestation for this wallet.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per wallet, with the social accounts its owner published.

matches_only.title: Reachable accounts
matches_only.description: Only the wallets that resolved to an X handle or a Farcaster account.
